events.title: Play the Phone Update at Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Your Painting, Sir is participating in Steam Next Fest! We also bring you a new update for the demo. This update features:Various Quality of Life changesMore variations when showing the painting to HectorThree side quests! An unlockable minigameThe side quests and minigame are done using a new feature: a mobile phone. Hector will gift it to you after completing three paintings. If you already completed three paintings before you should find the phone on the canvas view.This update adds about 30

events.title: Thank you for playing the demo!
events.summary: Thank youThank you all for playing the demo of Your Painting, Sir! When you work on a game for so long, you get desensitized to it, and you're not sure how new players will react when they play it for the first time. It's been great to see that so many people love the game! I'm also happy to reveal that we've reached the milestone of 25k wishlists! It has been far beyond our expectations.FeedbackA special thank you to everyone who took the time to leave a review and/or fill out the feedback form

events.title: Demo released!
events.summary: The demo for Your Painting, Sir has been released!In this demo, you will be able to play the first chapter of the game, and we give you a teaser for the second chapter.We're very excited for you to try out our game. Besides completing the demo, we also hope you have a lot of fun messing around in creative mode. We certainly do.
